The (−)-(S)-isomer of dropropizine. Леводропропизин C13H20N2O2 = 236.3. CAS — 99291-25-5. ATC — R05DB27. ATC Vet — QR05DB27. Pharmacopoeias. In Eur. (see p.vii). Ph. Eur. 6.2 (Levodropropizine). A white or almost white pow- der. Slightly soluble in water and in alcohol; freely soluble in di- lute acetic acid and in methyl alcohol. A 2.5% solution in water has a pH of 9.2 to 10.2. Protect from light. Profile Dropropizine is a cough suppressant reported to have a peripher- al action in non-productive cough (p.1547). It is given orally usu- ally in a dose of 30 mg three or four times daily.
